rationale: Every supplied artifact use preserves the claim's scope and limitations. Across the assurance case, method crosswalk, challenge findings, and script materials, the UK MAA regulatory notice (MAA/RN/2025/04) is consistently cited as military-specific informative guidance requiring architectural mitigation and a system-safety-case approach, rather than being overextended into civil airworthiness approval or an assertion that no prescriptive methods exist in other jurisdictions.
limitations: Review is bounded to the supplied project artifacts and the explicit text of UK MAA/RN/2025/04 paragraphs 13–14.
